   176	/-! ## Base change of the datum -/
   177	
   178	section Datum
   179	
   180	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   181	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
   182	variable (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B'] [IsScalarTower k B B']
   183	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]
   184	
   185	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule
   186	
   187	namespace BasicOpenCoverData
   188	
   189	variable (D : BasicOpenCoverData C B π)
   190	
   191	/-- **Base change of the basic-open cover data** along `B → B'`: the generators and
   192	partition coefficients push forward through the sections comparison map; the partition
   193	witnesses are carried by `map_sum`/`map_mul`/`map_one`. -/
   194	noncomputable def baseChange : BasicOpenCoverData C B' π where
   195	  J₀ := D.J₀
   196	  J₁ := D.J₁
   197	  fintype₀ := D.fintype₀
   198	  fintype₁ := D.fintype₁
   199	  h₀ j := relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.h₀ j)
   200	  h₁ j := relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.h₁ j)
   201	  a₀ j := relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.a₀ j)
   202	  a₁ j := relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.a₁ j)
   203	  partition₀ := by
   204	    have h := congrArg (relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₀ π)) D.partition₀
   205	    rw [map_sum, map_one] at h
   206	    rw [← h]
   207	    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (map_mul _ _ _).symm
   208	  partition₁ := by
   209	    have h := congrArg (relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₁ π)) D.partition₁
   210	    rw [map_sum, map_one] at h
   211	    rw [← h]
   212	    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (map_mul _ _ _).symm
   213	
   214	@[simp]
   215	lemma baseChange_h₀ (j : D.J₀) :
   216	    (D.baseChange B').h₀ j = relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.h₀ j) := rfl
   217	
   218	@[simp]
   219	lemma baseChange_h₁ (j : D.J₁) :
   220	    (D.baseChange B').h₁ j = relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.h₁ j) := rfl
   221	
   222	/-- **Pieces base-change to pieces**: the pieces of the base-changed cover data are the
   223	`relCurveMap`-preimages of the pieces. -/
   224	theorem pieces_baseChange (j : D.index) :
   225	    (D.baseChange B').pieces j = relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j := by
   226	  cases j with
   227	  | inl j => exact relSectionsMap_basicOpen C B B' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.h₀ j)
   228	  | inr j => exact relSectionsMap_basicOpen C B B' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.h₁ j)
   229	
   230	/-- The base-changed pieces are below the preimages of the pieces (the `≤`-form of
   231	`pieces_baseChange` consumed by `appLE`). -/
   232	lemma baseChange_pieces_le_preimage (j : D.index) :
   233	    (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j :=
   234	  (D.pieces_baseChange B' j).le
   235	
   236	/-- Double overlaps of base-changed pieces are below the preimages of the double
   237	overlaps. -/
   238	lemma baseChange_inf_le_preimage (i j : D.index) :
   239	    (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤
   240	      relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) := by
   241	  rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
   242	  exact inf_le_inf (D.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' i)
   243	    (D.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' j)
   244	
   245	/-- **The overlap comparison map**: sections on a double overlap of pieces compare to
   246	sections on the double overlap of the base-changed pieces, through `appLE` of the
   247	relative-curve comparison. -/
   248	noncomputable def overlapMap (i j : D.index) :
   249	    Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) →+*
   250	      Γ(relCurve C B', (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j) :=
   251	  ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   252	    ((D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j)
   253	    (D.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j)).hom
   254	
   255	end BasicOpenCoverData
   256	
   257	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
   258	
   259	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
   260	
   261	/-- **Base change of the pinned cocycle datum** along `B → B'` (stage (1d-ii), the
   262	datum half; the RE-5 descent/transport interface): generators, partition coefficients
   263	and transition units push forward through the relative-curve comparison; the cocycle
   264	identities are carried by ring-hom functoriality (`Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom`). -/
   265	noncomputable def baseChange : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B' π where
   266	  toBasicOpenCoverData := D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B'
   267	  unit i j := Units.map (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.overlapMap B' i j).toMonoidHom
   268	    (D.unit i j)
   269	  isGluingCocycle := by
   270	    constructor
   271	    · intro i
   272	      have h := D.isGluingCocycle.unit_self i
   273	      change (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.overlapMap B' i i)
   274	        ((D.unit i i : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i))) = 1
   275	      rw [h, map_one]
   276	    · intro i j l
   277	      -- the triple overlap of the base-changed pieces sits below the preimage of the
   278	      -- triple overlap
   279	      have htriple : (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
   280	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j ⊓
   281	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces l ≤
   282	          relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l) := by
   283	        rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
   284	        exact inf_le_inf (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j)
   285	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' l)
   286	      have key := congrArg
   287	        (((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l)
   288	          ((D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
   289	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j ⊓
   290	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces l) htriple).hom)
   291	        (D.isGluingCocycle.mul_res i j l)
   292	      rw [map_mul] at key
   293	      have e₁ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   294	        (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l ≤ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   295	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j) htriple
   296	        (inf_le_left : (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
   297	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j ⊓
   298	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces l ≤
   299	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
   300	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j)
   301	        ((D.unit i j : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)))
   302	      have e₂ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   303	        (gluedInclCoc D.pieces (D.pieces i) j l)
   304	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' j l) htriple
   305	        (gluedInclCoc (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces
   306	          ((D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i) j l)
   307	        ((D.unit j l : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l)))
   308	      have e₃ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   309	        (gluedInclSnd D.pieces (D.pieces i) j l)
   310	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i l) htriple
   311	        (gluedInclSnd (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces
   312	          ((D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i) j l)
   313	        ((D.unit i l : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces l)))
   314	      rw [← e₁, ← e₂, ← e₃] at key
   315	      simp only [Units.coe_map]
   316	      exact key
   317	
   318	@[simp]
   319	lemma baseChange_unit_coe (i j : D.index) :
   320	    (((D.baseChange B').unit i j :
   321	        Γ(relCurve C B',
   322	          (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j)ˣ) :
   323	      Γ(relCurve C B', (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j)) =
   324	      D.toBasicOpenCoverData.overlapMap B' i j
   325	        ((D.unit i j : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j))) := rfl
   326	
   327	/-! ## The componentwise comparison of glued sections -/
   328	
   329	section SectionsMap
   330	
   331	variable {W : (relCurve C B).Opens} {W' : (relCurve C B').Opens}
   332	
   333	/-- The component opens of the comparison sit below the preimages of the component
   334	opens. -/
   335	lemma sectionsMap_component_le (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W) (j : D.index) :
   336	    W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (W ⊓ D.pieces j) := by
   337	  rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
   338	  exact inf_le_inf hW' (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' j)
   339	
   340	/-- **The componentwise comparison of glued sections** along `B → B'`: apply `appLE` of
   341	the relative-curve comparison to every component. Matching is carried by
   342	`Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom` and the base-changed units. -/
   343	noncomputable def sectionsMap (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
   344	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) :
   345	    ↥(gluedSubmodule B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit W') := by
   346	  refine ⟨fun j => ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (W ⊓ D.pieces j)
   347	    (W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j) (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' j)).hom
   348	    (s.val j), ?_⟩
   349	  intro i j
   350	  have hdouble : W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤
   351	      relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (W ⊓ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) := by
   352	    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
   353	    exact inf_le_inf (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' i)
   354	      (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' j)
   355	  have key := congrArg
   356	    (((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (W ⊓ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   357	      (W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j) hdouble).hom)
   358	    ((mem_gluedSubmodule_iff B D.pieces D.unit
   359	      (s.val : ∀ l : D.index, Γ(relCurve C B, W ⊓ D.pieces l))).mp s.property i j)
   360	  rw [map_mul] at key
   361	  have e₁ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   362	    (inf_le_left : W ⊓ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ W ⊓ D.pieces i)
   363	    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' i) hdouble
   364	    (inf_le_left : W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤
   365	      W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces i) (s.val i)
   366	  have e₂ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   367	    (gluedInclCoc D.pieces W i j)
   368	    (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j) hdouble
   369	    (gluedInclCoc (D.baseChange B').pieces W' i j)
   370	    ((D.unit i j : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)))
   371	  have e₃ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   372	    (gluedInclSnd D.pieces W i j)
   373	    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' j) hdouble
   374	    (gluedInclSnd (D.baseChange B').pieces W' i j) (s.val j)
   375	  rw [← e₁, ← e₂, ← e₃] at key
   376	  exact key
   377	
   378	@[simp]
   379	lemma sectionsMap_coe (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
   380	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) (j : D.index) :
   381	    (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s).val j =
   382	      ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (W ⊓ D.pieces j)
   383	        (W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j)
   384	        (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' j)).hom (s.val j) := rfl
   385	
   386	/-- The comparison of glued sections is additive. -/
   387	lemma sectionsMap_add (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
   388	    (s t : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) :
   389	    D.sectionsMap B' hW' (s + t) = D.sectionsMap B' hW' s + D.sectionsMap B' hW' t := by
   390	  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun j => ?_)
   391	  have hst : (s + t).val j = s.val j + t.val j := rfl
   392	  have hst' : (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s + D.sectionsMap B' hW' t).val j =
   393	      (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s).val j + (D.sectionsMap B' hW' t).val j := rfl
   394	  rw [hst', sectionsMap_coe, sectionsMap_coe, sectionsMap_coe, hst, map_add]
   395	
   396	/-- **Semilinearity of the comparison of glued sections**: it intertwines the
   397	coefficient actions along `algebraMap B B'`. -/
   398	lemma sectionsMap_smul (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W) (b : B)
   399	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) :
   400	    D.sectionsMap B' hW' (b • s) = algebraMap B B' b • D.sectionsMap B' hW' s := by
   401	  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun j => ?_)
   402	  have hbs : ((b • s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W))).val j = b • s.val j := rfl
   403	  have hbs' : ((algebraMap B B' b • D.sectionsMap B' hW' s :
   404	      ↥(gluedSubmodule B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit W'))).val j =
   405	      algebraMap B B' b • (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s).val j := rfl
   406	  rw [hbs', sectionsMap_coe, sectionsMap_coe, hbs, Scheme.overModule_smul_def,
   407	    Scheme.overModule_smul_def, map_mul]
   408	  congr 1
   409	  exact relCurveMap_appLE_overAlgebraMap C B B' _ b
   410	
   411	/-- The comparison of glued sections commutes with restriction. -/
   412	lemma gluedRes_sectionsMap {V' V : (relCurve C B).Opens} (hV'V : V' ≤ V)
   413	    {P' P : (relCurve C B').Opens} (hP : P ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ V)
   414	    (hP' : P' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ V') (hPP : P' ≤ P)
   415	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit V)) :
   416	    gluedRes B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit hPP
   417	        (D.sectionsMap B' hP s) =
   418	      D.sectionsMap B' hP' (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit hV'V s) := by
   419	  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun j => ?_)
   420	  rw [gluedRes_coe, sectionsMap_coe, sectionsMap_coe, gluedRes_coe]
   421	  exact (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   422	    (inf_le_inf_right (D.pieces j) hV'V) (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hP j)
   423	    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hP' j)
   424	    (inf_le_inf_right ((D.baseChange B').pieces j) hPP) (s.val j)
   425	
   426	/-- **The comparison intertwines the piece trivializations with `appLE`**: on an open
   427	below a piece, trivializing the compared section is `appLE` of the trivialized
   428	section. -/
   429	lemma gluedTriv_sectionsMap (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W) {j : D.index}
   430	    (hWj : W ≤ D.pieces j) (hW'j : W' ≤ (D.baseChange B').pieces j)
   431	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) :
   432	    gluedTriv B' (D.baseChange B').isGluingCocycle j hW'j (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s) =
   433	      ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE W W'
   434	        (hW'.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ le_rfl))).hom
   435	        (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j hWj s) := by
   436	  rw [gluedTriv_apply, gluedTriv_apply, sectionsMap_coe]
   437	  exact (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom (le_inf le_rfl hWj)
   438	    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' j) (hW'.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ le_rfl))
   439	    (le_inf le_rfl hW'j) (s.val j)
   440	
   441	/-- **The comparison intertwines the componentwise chart actions**: acting by
   442	`r ∈ Γ(C_B, V)` then comparing equals comparing then acting by the compared scalar. -/
   443	lemma sectionsMap_gluedQsmul {V : (relCurve C B).Opens} {V' : (relCurve C B').Opens}
   444	    (hWV : W ≤ V) (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
   445	    (hV' : V' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ V) (hW'V' : W' ≤ V') (r : Γ(relCurve C B, V))
   446	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) :
   447	    D.sectionsMap B' hW' (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit hWV r s) =
   448	      gluedQsmul B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit hW'V'
   449	        (((relCurveMap C B B').appLE V V' hV').hom r) (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s) := by
   450	  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun j => ?_)
   451	  rw [sectionsMap_coe, gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe, sectionsMap_coe, map_mul]
   452	  congr 1
   453	  exact ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom (inf_le_left.trans hWV) hV'
   454	    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' j) (inf_le_left.trans hW'V') r).symm
   455	
   456	end SectionsMap

     9	/-!
    10	# H⁰ of the glued datum sheaf, on the nose (DAT-1, stage 1d-ii, the tail)
    11	
    12	The on-the-nose base-change export of the m-chart glued constructor's engine, mirroring the
    13	2-chart `relTwistH0BaseChange` (`RigidEngine4BaseChange`). The abstract kernel clause
    14	`datumH0BaseChangeEquiv` (`GluedSheafEngine`) is threaded through the stage-(1d-ii) chart-term
    15	identifications `termBaseChange`/`termBaseChange_tmul` (`GluedSheafTermBaseChangeEquiv`) onto
    16	`H⁰` of the base-changed datum sheaf.
    17	
    18	* `termBaseChange₀`/`termBaseChange₁`/`termBaseChangeInf` — the chart-term base changes at the
    19	  two pinned charts and their overlap.
    20	* `datumDomBaseChange` — the base change of the two-cover degree-zero term
    21	  `F(V₀ᴮ) × F(V₁ᴮ)`.
    22	* `datumDiffBaseChange` — **the δ-naturality square** (the glued analogue of
    23	  `relTwistDiffBaseChange`; no cocycle conjugation — the componentwise restrictions commute
    24	  with `sectionsMap` through `gluedRes_sectionsMap`).
    25	* `datumH0BaseChange` — **`H⁰` base change on the nose**:
    26	  `B' ⊗[B] H⁰(C_B, F_D) ≃ₗ[B'] H⁰(C_{B'}, F_{D'})` on the vanishing locus, for every ring map
    27	  `B → B'` (`D' = D.baseChange B'`) — the on-the-nose form RE-5's DAT-B route consumes.
    28	* `datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange` — **`H¹` vanishes after base change** on the vanishing
    29	  locus.
    30	-/

    57	/-- The chart-term base change at the pinned chart `V₀ᴮ`. -/
    58	noncomputable def termBaseChange₀ :
    59	    B' ⊗[B] (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ≃ₗ[B']
    60	      ((D.baseChange B').sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) := by
    61	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn D.sheaf
    62	      ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ (fiberTwoCover π).V₀) := D.instQcohOn₀
    63	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn (D.baseChange B').sheaf
    64	      ((fst C (overSpec k B')).left ⁻¹ᵁ (fiberTwoCover π).V₀) := (D.baseChange B').instQcohOn₀
    65	  exact D.termBaseChange B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₀ Sum.inl D.h₀
    66	    (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀.isCompact (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀.isQuasiSeparated
    67	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π)) (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
    68	    (fun _ _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ => rfl) (fun _ => le_rfl) D.span_range_h₀

    71	noncomputable def termBaseChange₁ :
    72	    B' ⊗[B] (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)) ≃ₗ[B']
    73	      ((D.baseChange B').sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)) := by

    79	    (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁.isCompact (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁.isQuasiSeparated

    83	/-- The chart-term base change at the overlap `V₀ᴮ ⊓ V₁ᴮ` (side-0's restricted family). -/
    84	noncomputable def termBaseChangeInf :
    85	    B' ⊗[B] (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op ((relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
    86	        (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) ≃ₗ[B']
    87	      ((D.baseChange B').sheaf.obj.obj (op ((relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
    88	        (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) := by
    89	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn D.sheaf
    90	      ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁)) :=
    91	    gluedQcohOn B D.pieces D.unit D.isGluingCocycle (σ := Sum.inl) (h := D.hInf)
    92	      D.basicOpen_hInf_le D.coverInf
    93	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn (D.baseChange B').sheaf
    94	      ((fst C (overSpec k B')).left ⁻¹ᵁ ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁)) :=
    95	    gluedQcohOn B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit
    96	      (D.baseChange B').isGluingCocycle (σ := Sum.inl) (h := (D.baseChange B').hInf)
    97	      (D.baseChange B').basicOpen_hInf_le (D.baseChange B').coverInf
    98	  exact D.termBaseChange B' ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁) Sum.inl D.hInf
    99	    (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen_inf.isCompact
   100	    (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen_inf.isQuasiSeparated
   101	    (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).isAffineOpen_inf
   102	    (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).isAffineOpen_inf
   103	    (fun _ _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ => rfl) D.basicOpen_hInf_le D.span_range_hInf
   104	
   105	/-- The chart-`V₀ᴮ` term base change on a pure tensor. -/
   106	theorem termBaseChange₀_tmul (b' : B')
   107	    (s : D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) :
   108	    D.termBaseChange₀ B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] s) =
   109	      b' • D.sectionsMap B' (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₀) s := by
   110	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn D.sheaf
   111	      ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ (fiberTwoCover π).V₀) := D.instQcohOn₀
   112	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn (D.baseChange B').sheaf
   113	      ((fst C (overSpec k B')).left ⁻¹ᵁ (fiberTwoCover π).V₀) := (D.baseChange B').instQcohOn₀
   114	  exact D.termBaseChange_tmul B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₀ Sum.inl D.h₀
   115	    (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀.isCompact (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀.isQuasiSeparated
   116	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π)) (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   117	    (fun _ _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ => rfl) (fun _ => le_rfl) D.span_range_h₀ b' s
   118	
   119	/-- The chart-`V₁ᴮ` term base change on a pure tensor. -/
   120	theorem termBaseChange₁_tmul (b' : B')
   121	    (s : D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)) :
   122	    D.termBaseChange₁ B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] s) =
   123	      b' • D.sectionsMap B' (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₁) s := by
   124	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn D.sheaf
   125	      ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁) := D.instQcohOn₁
   126	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn (D.baseChange B').sheaf
   127	      ((fst C (overSpec k B')).left ⁻¹ᵁ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁) := (D.baseChange B').instQcohOn₁
   128	  exact D.termBaseChange_tmul B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₁ Sum.inr D.h₁
   129	    (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁.isCompact (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁.isQuasiSeparated
   130	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover π)) (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   131	    (fun _ _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ => rfl) (fun _ => le_rfl) D.span_range_h₁ b' s
   132	
   133	/-- The overlap term base change on a pure tensor. -/
   134	theorem termBaseChangeInf_tmul (b' : B')
   135	    (s : D.sheaf.obj.obj (op ((relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   136	      (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) :
   137	    D.termBaseChangeInf B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] s) =
   138	      b' • D.sectionsMap B'
   139	        (le_preimage_chart B' ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁)) s := by
   140	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn D.sheaf
   141	      ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁)) :=
   142	    gluedQcohOn B D.pieces D.unit D.isGluingCocycle (σ := Sum.inl) (h := D.hInf)
   143	      D.basicOpen_hInf_le D.coverInf
   144	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn (D.baseChange B').sheaf
   145	      ((fst C (overSpec k B')).left ⁻¹ᵁ ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁)) :=
   146	    gluedQcohOn B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit
   147	      (D.baseChange B').isGluingCocycle (σ := Sum.inl) (h := (D.baseChange B').hInf)
   148	      (D.baseChange B').basicOpen_hInf_le (D.baseChange B').coverInf
   149	  exact D.termBaseChange_tmul B' ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁) Sum.inl D.hInf
   150	    (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen_inf.isCompact
   151	    (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen_inf.isQuasiSeparated
   152	    (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).isAffineOpen_inf
   153	    (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).isAffineOpen_inf
   154	    (fun _ _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ => rfl) D.basicOpen_hInf_le D.span_range_hInf b' s

   156	/-! ## The degree-zero term base change and the δ-naturality square -/
   157	
   158	/-- The base change of the two-cover degree-zero term `F(V₀ᴮ) × F(V₁ᴮ)`. -/
   159	noncomputable def datumDomBaseChange :
   160	    B' ⊗[B] ((D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   161	        (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) ≃ₗ[B']
   162	      ((D.baseChange B').sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   163	        ((D.baseChange B').sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)) :=
   164	  (TensorProduct.prodRight B B' B' _ _).trans
   165	    ((D.termBaseChange₀ B').prodCongr (D.termBaseChange₁ B'))
   166	
   167	/-- The degree-zero term base change on a pure tensor. -/
   168	lemma datumDomBaseChange_tmul (b' : B')
   169	    (p : (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   170	      (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) :
   171	    D.datumDomBaseChange B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p) =
   172	      (D.termBaseChange₀ B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p.1), D.termBaseChange₁ B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p.2)) := by
   173	  rw [datumDomBaseChange, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, TensorProduct.prodRight_tmul]
   174	  rfl
   175	
   176	set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
   177	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   178	/-- **The δ-naturality square** (the glued analogue of `relTwistDiffBaseChange`): the base
   179	change of the datum's Čech differential over `B` is carried to the datum's Čech differential
   180	over `B'` under the term identifications. There is no cocycle conjugation — the componentwise
   181	restrictions commute with `sectionsMap` through `gluedRes_sectionsMap`. -/
   182	theorem datumDiffBaseChange
   183	    (x : B' ⊗[B] ((D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   184	      (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)))) :
   185	    D.termBaseChangeInf B' (((datumPair D).diff).baseChange B' x) =
   186	      (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff (D.datumDomBaseChange B' x) := by
   187	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
   188	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
   189	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
   190	  | tmul b' p =>
   191	    have hbc : ((datumPair D).diff).baseChange B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p) =
   192	        b' ⊗ₜ[B] (datumPair D).diff p := LinearMap.baseChange_tmul _ _ _
   193	    rw [hbc]
   194	    simp only [D.datumDomBaseChange_tmul B', TwoLatticePair.diff_apply,
   195	      D.termBaseChange₀_tmul B', D.termBaseChange₁_tmul B']
   196	    rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, map_sub, D.termBaseChangeInf_tmul B',
   197	      D.termBaseChangeInf_tmul B', map_smul, map_smul]
   198	    congr 1
   199	    · congr 1
   200	      exact (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B'
   201	        (inf_le_left : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   202	          (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
   203	        (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₀)
   204	        (le_preimage_chart B' ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁))
   205	        (inf_le_left : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   206	          (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
   207	        p.1).symm
   208	    · congr 1
   209	      exact (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B'
   210	        (inf_le_right : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   211	          (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
   212	        (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₁)
   213	        (le_preimage_chart B' ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁))
   214	        (inf_le_right : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   215	          (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
   216	        p.2).symm

   218	/-! ## The on-the-nose H⁰ base change and H¹ vanishing -/
   219	
   220	open AlgebraicJacobian
   221	
   222	/-- **`H⁰` base change on the nose** (DAT-1 (1d-ii) tail; the RE-5/DAT-B transport interface):
   223	on the vanishing locus, for every ring map `B → B'`,
   224	
   225	`B' ⊗[B] H⁰(C_B, F_D) ≃ₗ[B'] H⁰(C_{B'}, F_{D'})`
   226	
   227	with `D' = D.baseChange B'` — the abstract kernel clause `datumH0BaseChangeEquiv` threaded
   228	through the term identifications by the δ-naturality square `datumDiffBaseChange`. -/
   229	noncomputable def datumH0BaseChange (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) :
   230	    B' ⊗[B] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B']
   231	      Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 0 :=
   232	  (datumH0BaseChangeEquiv D hH1 B').trans
   233	    ((RigidEngine.kerCongr ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange B')
   234	        ((datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff)
   235	        (D.datumDomBaseChange B') (D.termBaseChangeInf B')
   236	        (fun x => D.datumDiffBaseChange B' x)).trans
   237	      ((D.baseChange B').pairData.h0Equiv
   238	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   239	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   240	        (relCover_sup C B' (fiberTwoCover π))).symm)
   241	
   242	/-- **`H¹` vanishes after base change** on the vanishing locus: the base-changed Čech
   243	differential is surjective (right-exactness of `B' ⊗[B] -` plus the δ-square), so `H¹` of the
   244	base-changed datum sheaf vanishes. -/
   245	theorem datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) :
   246	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 1) := by
   247	  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (datumPair D).diff :=
   248	    D.pairData.surjective_diff (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π))
   249	      (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover π)) hH1
   250	  have hbc : Function.Surjective ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange B') := by
   251	    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
   252	    exact LinearMap.lTensor_surjective B' hsurj
   253	  have hsurj' : Function.Surjective (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff :=
   254	    RigidEngine.surjective_congr _ _ (D.datumDomBaseChange B') (D.termBaseChangeInf B')
   255	      (fun x => D.datumDiffBaseChange B' x) hbc
   256	  haveI : Subsingleton (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).H1 := by
   257	    have h : (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).imageLattice = ⊤ := by
   258	      rw [← (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).range_diff_eq, LinearMap.range_eq_top]
   259	      exact hsurj'
   260	    rw [TwoLatticePair.H1, h]
   261	    infer_instance
   262	  exact ((D.baseChange B').pairData.h1Equiv
   263	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   264	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   265	    (relCover_sup C B' (fiberTwoCover π))).toEquiv.subsingleton
   266	
   267	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum

     7	/-!
     8	# The native module carried by a glued rank-one datum
     9	
    10	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sheaf` is already a sheaf of modules over the coefficient
    11	ring.  The presentation contract also asks for the same object as a sheaf of
    12	modules over the structure sheaf of the relative curve.  This file supplies
    13	that bridge: the componentwise `gluedQsmul` action gives a module on every open,
    14	`gluedRes_gluedQsmul` gives the semilinearity needed by
    15	`PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf`, and `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies its
    16	restriction to the coefficient ring with the original datum sheaf.
    17	
    18	The canonical piece trivializations also prove that the native module is a line
    19	bundle.  Pushforward base-change and existence of a tied
    20	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` remain genuine producer obligations.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	
    25	universe u
    26	
    27	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
    28	
    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    30	
    31	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    32	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    33	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    34	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]
    35	
    36	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    37	
    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    41	
    42	/-- The structure-sheaf module on the sections of the glued datum over one open.
    43	
    44	The action is the componentwise multiplication action; the four module laws
    45	are inherited from the corresponding `gluedQsmul` identities. -/
    46	@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleOn (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
    47	    Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    48	      ((D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)).obj (op U)) := by
    49	  change Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    50	    (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U))
    51	  letI : SMul Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    52	      (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U)) :=
    53	    ⟨fun r s => gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s⟩
    54	  exact Module.ofMinimalAxioms
    55	    (fun r x y => gluedQsmul_add B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x y)
    56	    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_add_left B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    57	    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_mul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    58	    (fun x => gluedQsmul_one B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) x)
    59	
    60	/-- The presheaf of structure-sheaf modules underlying `D`. -/
    61	noncomputable def nativePresheaf : (relCurve C B).PresheafOfModules := by
    62	  let M : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat :=
    63	    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)
    64	  let family : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
    65	      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) :=
    66	    fun U => moduleOn D U.unop
    67	  letI : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
    68	      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) := family
    69	  exact PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf M (by
    70	    intro X Y f r m
    71	    change gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le
    72	        (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : X.unop ≤ X.unop) r m) =
    73	      gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : Y.unop ≤ Y.unop)
    74	        ((relCurve C B).resHom f.unop.le r)
    75	        (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le m)
    76	    rw [gluedRes_gluedQsmul]
    77	    apply Subtype.ext
    78	    funext j
    79	    rw [gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe]
    80	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom])

    82	/-- The native `Scheme.Modules` object associated to a glued datum. -/
    83	noncomputable def nativeModule : (relCurve C B).Modules := by
    84	  refine ⟨nativePresheaf D, ?_⟩
    85	  rw [show (nativePresheaf D).presheaf =
    86	    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat) from rfl]
    87	  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    88	    (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    89	  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    90	    (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} B))).mp D.sheaf.property using 1
    91	  all_goals rfl

    93	/-! ## Piecewise line-bundle trivializations -/
    94	
    95	/-- Sections of the native module over one cocycle piece are the structure-ring sections.
    96	
    97	The open-immersion ring equivalence transports the component trivialization from the ambient
    98	relative curve to the restricted scheme.  The `gluedTriv_gluedQsmul` identity is exactly the
    99	structure-sheaf semilinearity needed for this to be a linear equivalence over the restricted
   100	ring of sections. -/
   101	noncomputable def nativeModulePieceSectionsEquiv
   102	    (j : D.index) (V : (D.pieces j).toScheme.Opens) :
   103	    Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.pieces j).ι).obj (nativeModule D), V) ≃ₗ[
   104	      Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V)] Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V) := by
   105	  let e := gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)
   106	  let ρ := ((D.pieces j).ι.appIso V).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
   107	  let f : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.pieces j).ι).obj (nativeModule D), V) →ₗ[
   108	      Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V)] Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V) :=
   109	    { toFun := fun s => ρ (e s)
   110	      map_add' := by
   111	        intro s t
   112	        change ρ (e (s + t)) = ρ (e s) + ρ (e t)
   113	        change ρ (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) (s + t)) =
   114	          ρ (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) s) +
   115	            ρ (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) t)
   116	        rw [show gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) (s + t) =
   117	            gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) s +
   118	              gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) t by
   119	              exact (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)).map_add s t]
   120	        exact ρ.map_add _ _
   121	      map_smul' := by
   122	        intro r s
   123	        change ρ
   124	            (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)
   125	              (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl) (ρ.symm r) s)) =
   126	          r * ρ
   127	            (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) s)
   128	        rw [gluedTriv_gluedQsmul]
   129	        simp [ρ] }
   130	  apply LinearEquiv.ofBijective f
   131	  constructor
   132	  · intro s t h
   133	    have h' := congrArg ρ.symm h
   134	    dsimp [f] at h'
   135	    rw [ρ.symm_apply_apply, ρ.symm_apply_apply] at h'
   136	    exact (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)).injective h'
   137	  · intro r
   138	    refine ⟨e.symm (ρ.symm r), ?_⟩
   139	    change ρ (e (e.symm (ρ.symm r))) = r
   140	    rw [e.apply_symm_apply, ρ.apply_symm_apply]
   141	
   142	/-- The piecewise section equivalences assemble to a sheaf isomorphism with the unit module. -/
   143	noncomputable def nativeModulePieceSheafIso (j : D.index) :
   144	    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.pieces j).ι).obj (nativeModule D) ≅
   145	      SheafOfModules.unit (D.pieces j).toScheme.ringCatSheaf :=
   146	  (SheafOfModules.fullyFaithfulForget _).preimageIso
   147	    (PresheafOfModules.isoMk
   148	      (fun V => (nativeModulePieceSectionsEquiv D j V.unop).toModuleIso)
   149	      (fun {V W} f => by
   150	        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
   151	        apply LinearMap.ext
   152	        intro x
   153	        change
   154	          ((D.pieces j).ι.appIso W.unop).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
   155	              (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le W.unop)
   156	                (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit
   157	                  ((D.pieces j).ι.image_mono (leOfHom f.unop)) x)) =
   158	            (D.pieces j).toScheme.presheaf.map f
   159	              (((D.pieces j).ι.appIso V.unop).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
   160	                (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x))
   161	        rw [gluedTriv_res B D.isGluingCocycle j
   162	          ((D.pieces j).ι.image_mono (leOfHom f.unop))
   163	          ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x]
   164	        simp only [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
   165	        change
   166	          (relCurve C B).resHom
   167	              ((D.pieces j).ι.image_mono (leOfHom f.unop))
   168	              (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j
   169	                ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x) =
   170	            (relCurve C B).presheaf.map
   171	              ((D.pieces j).ι.opensFunctor.map f.unop).op
   172	              (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j
   173	                ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x)
   174	        rfl))
   175	
   176	/-- The canonical native module is locally a free rank-one structure-sheaf module. -/
   177	theorem nativeModule_isLineBundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle (nativeModule D) := by
   178	  intro x
   179	  let j := D.pieceIndex x
   180	  refine ⟨D.pieces j, D.mem_pieces_pieceIndex x, ?_⟩
   181	  exact ⟨nativeModulePieceSheafIso D j⟩
   182	
   183	/-- On every open, restricting `D.nativeModule` to the coefficient ring recovers
   184	the datum's original module of sections.
   185	
   186	The equivalence is the identity on sections. Its linearity is the substantive
   187	point: `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies the native structure-sheaf action
   188	of a coefficient scalar with the datum's coefficient action. -/
   189	noncomputable def nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv
   190	    (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
   191	    (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   192	      (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D)).obj.obj (op U) ≃ₗ[B]
   193	      D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) := by
   194	  let f :
   195	      (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   196	        (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D)).obj.obj (op U) →ₗ[B]
   197	        D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) :=
   198	    { toFun := fun x => x
   199	      map_add' := by
   200	        intros
   201	        rfl
   202	      map_smul' := by
   203	        intro r x
   204	        change gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U)
   205	            ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B U r) x =
   206	          r • (show D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) from x)
   207	        exact gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap B D.pieces D.unit
   208	          (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x }
   209	  exact LinearEquiv.ofBijective f ⟨fun _ _ h => h, fun y => ⟨y, rfl⟩⟩
   210	
   211	/-- The base-ring sheaf of `D.nativeModule` is canonically the datum sheaf.
   212	
   213	This has exactly the type of `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.module_iso` when the
   214	presentation's native module is chosen to be `D.nativeModule`. -/
   215	noncomputable def nativeModuleKSheafIso :
   216	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   217	      (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D) ≅ D.sheaf :=
   218	  (fullyFaithfulSheafToPresheaf _ _).preimageIso
   219	    (NatIso.ofComponents
   220	      (fun U => (nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv D U.unop).toModuleIso)
   221	      (fun {_ _} _ => by
   222	        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
   223	        apply LinearMap.ext
   224	        intro x
   225	        rfl))
   226

    11	/-!
    12	# DAT-C C2 — the rank-1 H⁰ export and the generator kit
    13	(`informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` GAP-3 Σ-RANK1, §2 (N1)/(N3))
    14	
    15	On the fibrewise h¹-vanishing locus, at fibre degree `n` with the base χ-normalization
    16	`χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n`, the datum engine's `H⁰` is an **invertible** module: finite,
    17	projective, and of stalk-rank exactly `1`.  This is the rank export the engine
    18	(`datumRigidEngine`, `Cohomology/GluedSheafEngine.lean`) leaves open — it delivers
    19	finite + projective, never `rankAtStalk = 1`.
    20	
    21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chi_relCurve` — the χ transport `χ(𝒪_{C_L}) = 1 − n` to every
    22	  field `L` of the test tower (base-field invariance of the genus, `chi_moduleKSheaf`
    23	  + `genus_baseField`; a re-derivation of the private lemma of `DivSchemeMonoBridgeRel`).
    24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one` — **the fibre
    25	  computation**: for a datum whose fibre class over `L` has `classDeg = n`, with `H¹` of
    26	  the base-changed sheaf vanishing, `h⁰(C_L, F_{D_L}) = 1` — the Riemann–Roch anchor
    27	  `h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi` (`n + (1 − n)`) read through the presentation
    28	  bridge `presentationSheafIso`.  The fibre geometric package is threaded as instance
    29	  arguments (`Curve.BaseChangeInstances`).
    30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one` — **Σ-RANK1,
    31	  the datum-level export**: on the vanishing locus (fibre degree `n`, `χ = 1 − n`),
    32	  `Module.rankAtStalk (H⁰(F_D)) p = 1`.  Route: `Module.rankAtStalk_eq` reads the rank as
    33	  the `κ(p)`-fibre dimension; `datumH0BaseChange` (on the nose) identifies the fibre with
    34	  `H⁰(C_{κ(p)}, F_{D_{κ(p)}})`; the fibre computation above pins it at `1`.
    35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamily.rankAtStalk_divisorDatum_eq_one` — the
    36	  certified-family specialization (**N1**): for `G` landing in the h¹-vanishing locus
    37	  `V`, the divisor datum `D_G := G.adaptation.divisorDatum` has invertible `H⁰`.  The
    38	  fibre-degree hypothesis is discharged uniformly by `DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass` (the
    39	  fibre class has `classDeg = n` at every field).
    40	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamily.exists_fibrewise_generator_divisorDatum`
    41	  — **N3, the generator kit**: since `H⁰(F_{D_G})` is projective of rank `1` (hence has a
    42	  nontrivial fibre at every prime of the locus), a fibrewise-nonzero **global** section
    43	  exists Zariski-locally (`Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective`).
    44	
    45	Noetherian discipline (worksheet §2): every rank statement carries `[IsNoetherianRing S]`
    46	through the engine; the arbitrary-test consumers reach it through RE-5 stages.
    47	-/

    78	/-! ## The χ transport to the fibre curve -/

    80	/-- **`χ(𝒪) = 1 − n` at every field extension**, from the base normalization
    81	(`chi_moduleKSheaf` at the base-changed bundle + `genus_baseField`; a re-derivation of the
    82	`DivSchemeMonoBridgeRel` private lemma). -/
    83	theorem chi_relCurve (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
    84	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    85	    Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) = 1 - (n : ℤ) := by
    86	  haveI : IsProper (baseChangeBundle C L).hom := instIsProperSndLeft C L
    87	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
    88	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionSndLeft C L
    89	  haveI : GeometricallyIrreducible (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
    90	    instGeometricallyIrreducibleSndLeft C L
    91	  have h1 : Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L)
    92	      = 1 - (genus (baseChangeBundle C L) : ℤ) := chi_moduleKSheaf (baseChangeBundle C L)
    93	  have h2 : genus (baseChangeBundle C L) = genus C := genus_baseField C L
    94	  have h3 : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (genus C : ℤ) := chi_moduleKSheaf C
    95	  have h4 : (genus C : ℤ) = (n : ℤ) := by rw [h3] at hχ; linarith
    96	  rw [h1, h2, h4]

    98	/-! ## The fibre computation: `h⁰(C_L, F_{D_L}) = 1`
    99	
   100	The fibre geometric instances (`Curve.BaseChangeInstances`) are threaded as instance
   101	arguments — they cannot be synthesized through the `relCurve` `def` barrier, so consumers
   102	install them by `haveI` (the `degAt_abelDiv` block, I-0249 (iv)) before calling. -/
   103	
   104	/-- **The fibre h⁰ pin**: for a datum whose fibre class over the field `L` has
   105	`classDeg = n`, with the base χ-normalization and vanishing `H¹` of the base-changed
   106	sheaf, the fibre global-section count is exactly `1` — the Riemann–Roch rank anchor
   107	`h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi` read through the presentation bridge
   108	`presentationSheafIso`, at `n + (1 − n)`. -/
   109	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one
   110	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C S π)
   111	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
   112	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra S L] [IsScalarTower k S L]
   113	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C L)]
   114	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))]
   115	    [QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))]
   116	    [Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0)]
   117	    [Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1)]
   118	    (hg : classDeg L (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ))
   119	    (hsub : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange L).sheaf 1)) :
   120	    Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf = 1 := by
   121	  set P : (relCurve C L).MeromorphicPresentation :=
   122	    Scheme.MeromorphicPresentation.ofCocycle (D.baseChange L).pointedCover
   123	      (gluedSubordCocycle (D.baseChange L).isGluingCocycle
   124	        (D.baseChange L).pointedCover (D.baseChange L).pieceIndex
   125	        fun _ => le_rfl) with hP
   126	  have hsubP : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (P.gluedSheaf L) 1) :=
   127	    (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv (presentationSheafIso (D.baseChange L)) 1).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mp
   128	      hsub
   129	  have h0eq : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf = Sheaf.h0 (P.gluedSheaf L) :=
   130	    Sheaf.h0_congr (presentationSheafIso (D.baseChange L))
   131	  have hformula := h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi L P hsubP
   132	  have hPclass : P.picClass = (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass := rfl
   133	  have hint : (Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf : ℤ) = 1 := by
   134	    rw [h0eq, hformula, hPclass, hg, chi_relCurve hχ L]; ring
   135	  exact_mod_cast hint

   137	/-! ## Σ-RANK1: the rank-1 export on the vanishing locus -/
   138	
   139	/-- **Σ-RANK1, the datum-level rank export** (worksheet GAP-3): on the fibrewise
   140	h¹-vanishing locus, at fibre degree `n` with the base χ-normalization `χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n`,
   141	the datum engine's `H⁰` has stalk-rank exactly `1` at `p`.
   142	
   143	`Module.rankAtStalk_eq` reads the rank as the `κ(p)`-dimension of the fibre
   144	`κ(p) ⊗[S] H⁰`; the on-the-nose base change `datumH0BaseChange` identifies this fibre with
   145	`H⁰(C_{κ(p)}, F_{D_{κ(p)}})`, whose dimension is `1` by the fibre computation. The global
   146	fibrewise hypothesis `hfib` supplies finiteness/projectivity (hence flatness) through
   147	`datumRigidEngine`. -/
   148	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one
   149	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C S π) [IsNoetherianRing S]
   150	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   151	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
   152	    (hfib : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S,
   153	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[S] q.asIdeal.ResidueField))
   154	    (p : PrimeSpectrum S)
   155	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField)]
   156	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
   157	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   158	    [QuasiCompact
   159	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   160	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   161	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0)]
   162	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   163	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1)]
   164	    (hg : classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   165	      (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ)) :
   166	    Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p = 1 := by
   167	  obtain ⟨-, hfin, hproj⟩ := datumRigidEngine D hπ hfib
   168	  haveI := hfin
   169	  haveI := hproj
   170	  have hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1 := datum_subsingleton_pairH1 D hπ hfib
   171	  have hfibre : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf = 1 :=
   172	    D.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one hχ p.asIdeal.ResidueField hg
   173	      (D.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1)
   174	  calc Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p
   175	      = Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   176	          (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[S] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)) :=
   177	        Module.rankAtStalk_eq p
   178	    _ = Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   179	          (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf 0) :=
   180	        (D.datumH0BaseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1).finrank_eq
   181	    _ = Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf := rfl
   182	    _ = 1 := hfibre
   183	
   184	/-! ## The certified-family specialization: N1 (invertible `H⁰`) and N3 (generators) -/
   185	
   186	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
   187	/-- (Implementation) The fibre class of the divisor datum has `classDeg = n` at `κ(p)`:
   188	the base change of `G.eqns`, read through `DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass`. -/

    16	/-!
    17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
    18	
    19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
    20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
    21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
    22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
    23	
    24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
    25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
    26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
    27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
    28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
    29	
    30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
    31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
    32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
    33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
    34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
    35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
    36	-/

    59	/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.
    60	
    61	The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
    62	witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
    63	relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
    64	underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
    65	structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    66	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    67	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    68	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    69	  represents :
    70	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    71	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    72	  datum_class :
    73	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    74	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    75	  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules
    76	  module_iso :
    77	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
    78	      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf
    79	  line_bundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle module
    80	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    81	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    82	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    83	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    84	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    85	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),

   214	the coefficient ring `B` and `relCurveMap` explicit while retaining the canonical cartesian
   215	square, rather than introducing a second base-change witness. -/
   216	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIsoAffine_hom_evaluation
   217	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   218	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   219	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   220	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso
   221	      (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   222	      (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   223	      (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   224	      (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C
   225	        (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))).hom ≫
   226	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   227	          (snd C (overSpec k B)).left).counit.app
   228	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) =
   229	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).map P.evaluation := by
   230	  exact P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
   231	    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   232	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   233	    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   234	    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))

   238	/-- The global datum section represented by a degree-zero cohomology class. -/
   239	noncomputable def datumSection (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   240	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   241	    P.datum.sheaf.obj.obj (op (⊤ : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens)) :=
   242	  Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   243	    (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   244	    isTerminalTop P.datum.sheaf y
   245	
   246	/-! The datum-side section after coefficient extension.  This deliberately stops at the
   247	glued cocycle sheaf; identifying it with native `Scheme.Modules` global sections is a
   248	separate contract and is not smuggled in here. -/
   249	noncomputable def datumSectionBaseChange (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   250	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   251	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B]
   252	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   253	    (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf.obj.obj
   254	      (op (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)) :=
   255	  Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   256	    (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   257	    isTerminalTop (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf
   258	    (P.h0BaseChange B ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y))
   259	
   260	/-- H⁰ base change transports the tied datum section to the canonical glued-section map. -/
   261	theorem datumSectionBaseChange_one_tmul (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   262	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   263	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B]
   264	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   265	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y =
   266	      P.datum.sectionsMapTop B (P.datumSection y) := by
   267	  exact P.datum.linearEquiv₀_datumH0BaseChange_one_tmul B
   268	    ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing) y
   269	
   270	/-- The linear map underlying the canonical base-changed datum-section construction. -/
   271	noncomputable def datumSectionBaseChangeLinearMap
   272	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   273	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   274	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   275	    (B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) →ₗ[B]
   276	      (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf.obj.obj
   277	        (op (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)) :=
   278	  ((P.h0BaseChange B).trans
   279	    (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   280	      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   281	      isTerminalTop (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf)).toLinearMap

   284	theorem datumSectionBaseChangeLinearMap_one_tmul
   285	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   286	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   287	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B]
   288	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   289	    P.datumSectionBaseChangeLinearMap B ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y) =
   290	      P.datumSectionBaseChange B y := by

   294	-- The composed H⁰ equivalences create a large dependent linear-map elaboration.
   295	/-- Equality of localized H⁰ generators transports canonically to the associated datum
   296	sections.  This exposes the linearity used by fixed-open divisor canonicality without choosing
   297	a second section comparison. -/
   298	theorem datumSectionBaseChange_eq_smul_of_tensor_eq
   299	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   300	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   301	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B]
   302	    (y y' : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) (v : B)
   303	    (h : (1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y' =
   304	      v • ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y)) :
   305	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y' =
   306	      v • P.datumSectionBaseChange B y := by
   307	  rw [← P.datumSectionBaseChangeLinearMap_one_tmul B y',
   308	    ← P.datumSectionBaseChangeLinearMap_one_tmul B y,
   309	    ← map_smul, h]

   311	/-- The conditional divisor datum cut by a base-changed presentation section.
   312	
   313	The explicit `hsec` hypothesis is the non-vacuous fibrewise nonvanishing input.  It is
   314	converted componentwise to the injectivity required by the fibrewise-regular section
   315	construction; the integral fibre instance is installed from the standing geometrically
   316	irreducible curve hypotheses.
   317	-/
   318	noncomputable def sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange
   319	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   320	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   321	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
   322	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   323	    (hsec : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
   324	      (P.datum.baseChange B).sectionsMapTop q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   325	        (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y) ≠ 0) :
   326	    (relCurve C B).LocalEquations :=
   327	  let D := P.datum.baseChange B
   328	  let s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤) :=
   329	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y
   330	  D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s
   331	    (fun j q => by
   332	      letI : IsIntegral (relCurve C q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   333	        instIsIntegralBaseChange C q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   334	      exact D.injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero s q (hsec q) j)
   335	
   336	/-- The conditional section construction preserves the base-changed datum's Picard class. -/
   337	theorem sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange_picClass
   338	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   339	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   340	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
   341	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   342	    (hsec : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
   343	      (P.datum.baseChange B).sectionsMapTop q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   344	        (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y) ≠ 0) :
   345	    (P.sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange B y hsec).picClass =
   346	      (P.datum.baseChange B).cechPicClass := by
   347	  let D := P.datum.baseChange B
   348	  let s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤) :=
   349	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y
   350	  unfold sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange
   351	  exact D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular_picClass s
   352	    (fun j q => by
   353	      letI : IsIntegral (relCurve C q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   354	        instIsIntegralBaseChange C q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   355	      exact D.injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero s q (hsec q) j)

   358	noncomputable def moduleSectionsEquiv (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
   359	    Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ≃ₗ[P.cover.Carrier] Γ(P.module, ⊤) :=
   360	  (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv P.module_iso.symm 0).trans

   178	/-! ## The keystones -/
   179	
   180	section Keystones
   181	
   182	variable [IsFinite π] (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
   183	variable (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   184	
   185	/-- (Implementation) The two-lattice pair of the datum's glued sheaf. -/
   186	noncomputable abbrev datumPair :=
   187	  D.pairData.pair (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π))
   188	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover π))
   189	
   190	include hπ in
   191	/-- **The rigid engine on the pinned cocycle datum** (Kleiman 3.10 (v)⟹(i)+(iii),
   192	curve-lite; spec (1d-i), all hypotheses discharged): if every residue-field fibre of
   193	`H¹` of the two-lattice pair of the datum's glued sheaf vanishes (complex form — the
   194	sheaf-level discharge is the W6-full seam), then
   195	
   196	* `H¹(C_B, F_D) = 0`,
   197	* `H⁰(C_B, F_D)` is a finite projective `B`-module. -/
   198	theorem datumRigidEngine [IsNoetherianRing B]
   199	    (hfib : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum B,
   200	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :
   201	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 1) ∧
   202	      Module.Finite B (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) ∧
   203	      Module.Projective B (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) := by
   204	  haveI := D.moduleFinite_aeval'_pair_t₀ hπ
   205	  haveI := D.moduleFinite_aeval'_pair_t₁ hπ
   206	  haveI := D.projective_sections₀
   207	  haveI := D.projective_sections₁
   208	  haveI := D.projective_sectionsInf
   209	  haveI : Module.Projective B
   210	      ((D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   211	        (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) :=
   212	    Module.Projective.prod
   213	  exact D.pairData.rigidEngine
   214	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π))
   215	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover π))
   216	    (relCover_sup C B (fiberTwoCover π)) hfib
   217	
   218	include hπ in
   219	/-- **The openness export on the datum** (the strata gift): the fibrewise-vanishing
   220	locus of `H¹` of the datum pair is open in `Spec B`. Noetherian-free (COH-1 + RE-2). -/
   221	theorem datumRigidEngine_isOpen_vanishing :
   222	    IsOpen {p : PrimeSpectrum B |
   223	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField)} := by
   224	  haveI := D.moduleFinite_aeval'_pair_t₀ hπ
   225	  haveI := D.moduleFinite_aeval'_pair_t₁ hπ
   226	  exact D.pairData.rigidEngine_isOpen_vanishing
   227	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π))
   228	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover π))
   229	
   230	/-- **The module-coefficient clause on the datum** (Kleiman `eq:Q`): on the vanishing
   231	locus, formation of `H⁰(C_B, F_D)` commutes with `⊗_B P` for **every** `B`-module
   232	`P`. -/
   233	noncomputable def datumH0TensorEquiv (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1)
   234	    (P : Type u) [AddCommGroup P] [Module B P] :
   235	    (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) ⊗[B] P ≃ₗ[B]
   236	      ↥(LinearMap.ker ((datumPair D).diff.rTensor P)) := by
   237	  haveI := D.projective_sectionsInf
   238	  exact D.pairData.h0TensorEquiv
   239	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π))
   240	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover π))
   241	    (relCover_sup C B (fiberTwoCover π)) hH1 P
   242	
   243	/-- **The ring-map base-change clause on the datum, abstract half**: on the vanishing
   244	locus, `B' ⊗[B] H⁰(C_B, F_D)` is `B'`-linearly the kernel of the base-changed Čech
   245	differential, for **every** `B`-algebra `B'`. Threading onto `H⁰` of the base-changed
   246	sheaf on the nose is stage (1d-ii) — the RE-5/DAT-3 transport interface. -/
   247	noncomputable def datumH0BaseChangeEquiv (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1)
   248	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra B B'] :
   249	    B' ⊗[B] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B']
   250	      ↥(LinearMap.ker ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange B')) := by
   251	  haveI := D.projective_sectionsInf
   252	  exact D.pairData.h0BaseChangeEquiv
   253	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π))
   254	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover π))
   255	    (relCover_sup C B (fiberTwoCover π)) hH1 B'
   256	
   257	include hπ in
   258	/-- **The vanishing hypothesis in pair form from the fibre form** — convenience
   259	wrapper: COH-1 + Nakayama propagation for the datum pair (Noetherian-free). Consumers
   260	holding the fibrewise hypothesis feed `datumH0TensorEquiv`/`datumH0BaseChangeEquiv`
   261	through this. -/
   262	theorem datum_subsingleton_pairH1
   263	    (hfib : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum B,
   264	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :
   265	    Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1 := by
   266	  haveI := D.moduleFinite_aeval'_pair_t₀ hπ
   267	  haveI := D.moduleFinite_aeval'_pair_t₁ hπ
   268	  haveI : Module.Finite B (datumPair D).H1 := (datumPair D).moduleFinite_h1
   269	  exact AlgebraicJacobian.RigidEngine.subsingleton_of_forall_subsingleton_residueField_tensor
   270	    hfib
